title: Blood Kinship Proof · Ling Yuan's Origin
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji turned to leave, an ancient yet clear voice pierced through the void and exploded directly in his Mental Sea—'I have waited for you for a long time, child of the Chen family.' The blood pulse resonance contained within that voice caused Chen Ji to freeze completely, turning back in disbelief toward the depths of the secret realm."

text.content: "The exit light of the secret realm was blinding, yet Chen Ji felt the spiritual energy around him solidify in that instant. The words from that figure moments ago still felt like ice daggers piercing his heart, but before he could recover from that suffocating sensation of being gazed upon by the heavens, the ancient altar beneath his feet suddenly erupted with ghostly blue light. A stone tablet sealed for ten thousand years slowly rose from the earth, its runes moving like living creatures before finally settling into two lines of text that made his blood run backward."

"'Blood Resonance Holders: Ling Yuan, Chen Ji. Inheritance Sequence: Same Source, Diverging Branches.' Chen Ji stared fixedly at that line of text, each stroke feeling like a branding iron searing his eyes. Same Source, Diverging Branches—what did these four characters mean? It meant they shared a common ancestor. It meant that Ling Yuan, this old fox who had been 'protecting' him all along with the posture of an elder, actually shared the same blood with him!"

"Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. As someone who never believed in coincidences, he had never failed in his calculations, yet the bloodline record on this stone tablet was so clear he could not refute it. He forced himself to冷静, attempting to divine using the incomplete Tianji Record—but every time he glimpsed images of Ling Yuan, they were blurred and unclear, as if a mist of kinship shrouded the truth. Chen Xuan's name flickered vaguely at the bottom of the tablet, like some cross-temporal mockery."

"Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing peculiarly in the empty secret realm. He laughed until his shoulders shook, until his eye corners turned red, until the veins on the back of his hand gripping the Tianji Record bulged. So that's how it was—this was the one element he'd missed despite years of scheming. The sworn enemy was no one else, but his blood-related elder! And this 'waste,' raised under his very nose like a chess piece!"

dialogue.content: "What a fine 'Same Source, Diverging Branches'! What a fine Ling Yuan! After raising me for so many years, were you waiting for me to walk into a deadly trap myself, or for me to personally kill my own blood-related elder?"

text.content: "He took a deep breath, yet could not suppress the surging rage in his chest. The Tianji Record fragment in his palm grew slightly warm, that familiar force seemingly reminding him: Host, your anger is consuming your Heavenly Fate. But at this moment, what did Chen Ji care about any of this? He only knew that his twenty-year persona of 'playing dumb to devour the tiger' had become utterly ridiculous—because the real tiger had always been Ling Yuan."

"The light on the tablet gradually dimmed, yet another more blinding light shone from the depths of the secret realm. Chen Ji abruptly looked up to see a familiar figure walking across the void toward him—Ling Yuan, this old Sect Master he had been secretly guarding against for years, now gazing at him with a meaningful smile, as if observing a piece of art carefully cultivated for many years."

dialogue.content: "Ji'er, you saw that tablet? Master has waited a long time for this moment."

text.content: "Chen Ji's fingernails dug deeply into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he felt nothing. He stared at Ling Yuan's composed face, his mind racing: How long has Ling Yuan known about the blood relationship? Did he know from the very beginning? Was that so-called 'protection' merely bait for raising fish? Was every single one of his calculations within Ling Yuan's calculations?"

choice.prompt: "Facing Ling Yuan's 'concern,' how should Chen Ji respond to this blood kinship confrontation?"

choices.text: "Coldly questioning: Can blood ties offset scheming?"
choices.description: "Tear apart the pretense, counter Ling Yuan's warm offensive with cold indifference, directly exposing the essence of exploitation beneath the name of blood kinship."
choices.risk_hint: "Prematurely Revealing Strength May Invite Greater Crisis"

text.content: "Chen Ji收起 all the timidity and stupidity from his face, revealing his true expression—that of cold indifference and mockery after seeing through everything. 'Master's call of 'Ji'er,' how many years has it been? Did you truly treat me as a disciple-grandson, or as a bird caged in your palm?' His voice was not loud, yet every word was like a poisoned blade."

choices.text: "Lowering Eyes in Silence: Continue Playing the Waste to Observe Weaknesses"
choices.description: "Forcefully restrain anger to maintain his persona, perform a scene of 'shocked and confused upon learning the truth' before Ling Yuan, secretly searching for weaknesses."

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, his shoulders trembling slightly, fully performing the reaction a waste should have upon learning he was used by his close kin. But his eyes never stopped watching Ling Yuan's sleeve—there hid a jade pendant emanating ancient air, its patterns matching the runes on the edge of the Tianji Record fragment exactly."

choices.text: "Directly Lay Cards on Table: Ask Who Chen Xuan Really Is"
choices.description: "Bypass Ling Yuan's probing, strike directly at the core question—what is the relationship between Chen Xuan, the Tianji Record, and the bloodline inheritance?"
choices.risk_hint: "Expose Recognition of Connection Between Chen Xuan and Tianji Record"

text.content: "'Chen Xuan.' Chen Ji spat out these two characters like a drawn sword. 'His name appears on the tablet, and both our bloodlines point to him. Ling Yuan, you call me Ji'er repeatedly, but in your heart, have you always treated me as a substitute for Chen Xuan?' The curve of Chen Ji's mouth twisted into a mocking arc, that smile more miserable than crying."

"Ling Yuan did not fly into a rage; instead, he revealed a meaningful smile. 'A substitute? No, you are more suitable than Chen Xuan.' He stepped forward slowly, each step stepping on Chen Ji's heartstrings. 'You think the Tianji Record chose you? No, it was the bloodline that chose, it was the karma left by Chen Xuan that chose both you and me.' Ling Yuan's voice carried a twisted gentleness, 'The blood in your veins carries mine and Chen Xuan's. This chess game began writing itself the moment you were born.'"

"Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Chen Xuan's blood? What did that mean? Was Chen Xuan also Ling Yuan's blood relative? What was his relationship with Ling Yuan—grandfather and grandson, or brothers? Countless threads of clues tangled in his mind, yet he could not sort them out. The Tianji Record in his palm grew warm, as if warning him—dig any deeper, and he would touch certain taboos that should not be touched."

dialogue.content: "Want to know the answer? Come back to the Tianqing Sect with me. Ji'er, the account between us will be settled slowly."

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly felt a peculiar pulse surge from deep within his bloodline, a resonance with Ling Yuan of the same origin. He instinctively stepped back, yet no matter how he suppressed it, the half of his bloodline belonging to Ling Yuan was churning unrest, as if responding to some ancient summoning. He bit down hard on his molars until his knuckles whitened—this body had betrayed him!"

choice.prompt: "The blood resonance nearly drove Chen Ji out of control. How should he break this predicament?"

choices.text: "Forcefully Cut the Resonance with the Tianji Record's Power"
choices.description: "Consume Heavenly Fate Value, use the Tianji Record's power to tear a fissure in the blood resonance, temporarily isolating Ling Yuan's influence."

text.content: "Chen Ji fiercely bit through his tongue, spraying a mouthful of essence blood onto the Tianji Record fragment. The ancient paper instantly erupted with blinding golden light, and the resonance shrouding his bloodline was struck like thunder, shattering completely. Ling Yuan's brow furrowed for the first time, the playfulness in his eyes turning to genuine surprise and wariness."

choices.text: "Submit to the Resonance, Reverse-trace the Bloodline Source"
choices.description: "Use his own method to counter him,借着血脉共鸣 actively trace Ling Yuan's past, trying to find his weaknesses."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not resist that resonance; instead, he actively opened his bloodline channel. In an instant, countless broken images flooded into his Mental Sea like a flood—Ling Yuan a hundred years ago kneeling before a young man, that young man's face exactly matching the figure on the Tianji Record's cover. 'Master... Why was the Tianji Record chosen by him and not me?' Young Ling Yuan's eyes were full of madness and jealousy."

choices.text: "Use Mockery and Provocation to Force Ling Yuan to Show Weaknesses"
choices.description: "No more enduring, directly use words to stimulate Ling Yuan's emotions, making him lose his composure from anger, exposing more weaknesses."
choices.visible_reward: "Ling Yuan Loses Control and Shows More Weaknesses"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan's Strength Far Exceeds Chen Ji's; Direct Conflict Dangerous"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suddenly snorted a laugh, that laughter full of mockery and desolation. 'So that's how it is, Ling Yuan. What you hate is not Chen Xuan, but that the Tianji Record didn't choose you, right? How does it feel to be abandoned by your own inheritance? No wonder you raised me as a chess piece—you want to prove personally that without the Tianji Record, you can still win!'"

text.content: "Ling Yuan's expression finally cracked. That perpetually composed face flickered with a hint of ferocity, though just for an instant, yet Chen Ji caught it all. Effective indeed—this old fox's greatest knot of obsession was the shame of being abandoned by the Tianji Record back then. Chen Ji coldly thought in his heart: Infallible calculations? Your greatest vulnerability is your inability to accept being denied by fate in the past."

"'What sharp tongues you have, Ji'er.' Ling Yuan's voice suddenly turned cold, his aura pressing down like mountains. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest—that was the pressure of a high-level cultivator—the pressure of a Nascent Soul stage expert that a Foundation Building stage waste like him had no strength to resist. But he did not retreat; instead, he stood straight under the pressure, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth, yet he smiled."

dialogue.content: "'Senior's pressure is like mountains, the junior is humbled.' Chen Ji wiped away the blood at the corner of his mouth, his gaze icy as frost, 'Unfortunately, the more you try to suppress me with blood and strength, the more it proves I've touched your sore spot. The Tianji Record didn't choose you—that is fact. You've hated Chen Xuan your whole life, hated the Tianji Record your whole life, and now you want me to complete something for you? Dream on!'"

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan's pressure closes in step by step. How should Chen Ji break this situation?"

choices.text: "Retreat to Advance, Pretend Obedience to Buy Time"
choices.description: "Temporarily retract his sharpness, express willingness to return to the Tianqing Sect with Ling Yuan for negotiations, actually secretly seeking opportunities to escape and counterattack."

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly retracted all his sharpness, lowering his eyelids to hide the hatred and scheming in his eyes. 'Fine, I'll go with you.' His voice returned to that timidity and mediocrity, as if that sharp questioner just now was merely an illusion. Ling Yuan's pressure relaxed somewhat, a hint of satisfaction flickering in his eyes—he did not know, this was the beginning of his greatest mistake."

choices.text: "Brandish the Tianji Record Fragment as Leverage"
choices.description: "Explicitly tell Ling Yuan that the Tianji Record is the key piece for his schemes across the world, forcing Ling Yuan to choose between destroying him and using him."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record fragment from his chest, that yellowed paper glowing faintly before Ling Yuan. 'You want this, don't you? Kill me, and it dissipates completely; keep me, and you can still use it for your schemes across the world.' Chen Ji's smile carried a hint of madness, 'Ling Yuan, let's make a deal—you want to use me, and I can use you just as well.'"

choices.text: "Summon Mo Xiansheng's Residual Soul to Inquire the Truth"
choices.description: "Urgently call out to Mo Xiansheng, the guardian of the first page of the Tianji Record, within the Mental Sea, attempting to obtain key information about the bloodline and Chen Xuan."

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul faintly manifested, those eyes that had seen through millennia glancing at the external Ling Yuan, sighing. 'You ask about bloodlines? Ling Yuan and Chen Xuan are blood brothers. As for you... child, you are the incarnation of another strand of soul separated from Chen Xuan's reincarnation. What Ling Yuan hates was never Chen Xuan, but himself for failing to protect his younger brother back then.'"

"Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply, as if hearing something inconceivable. He stared fixedly at Chen Ji, his eyes' emotions complex beyond measure—a mixture of hatred, pain, obsession, and a trace even he himself was unwilling to admit... guilt. Chen Ji's heart shivered. Mo Xiansheng's words were like a thunderbolt splitting open the mist before his eyes. Blood brothers? Chen Xuan's reincarnation? So all this hatred and entanglement originated from a fraternal rift ten thousand years ago."

"'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned hoarse, that was not fear, but some more complex emotion churning within. He looked at Ling Yuan, suddenly understanding the ten-thousand-year loneliness and regret hidden in those eyes. This old fox had pursued him life after life, not because of hatred, but because—he could not forgive himself for failing to protect his younger brother back then. 'Ling Yuan, raising me for so long—are you trying to atone for your sins, or hoping to see me live as Chen Xuan did?'"

"Ling Yuan's form trembled slightly, and genuine cracks finally appeared on that ageless face. He opened his mouth as if to say something, but ultimately only let out a heavy sigh. The spiritual energy within the secret realm suddenly fluctuated violently, and the runes on the stone tablet lit up again—this time projecting a scene Chen Ji had never seen—ten thousand years ago, two young men standing side by side, one of them's brows and eyes exactly matching Chen Ji's."

"'Chen Xuan...' Ling Yuan's voice suddenly turned ancient and weary, 'I searched for you for ten thousand years, waited for you for ten thousand years, hated you for ten thousand years... In the end, you reincarnated as my disciple-grandson, and still must call me Master.' He suddenly laughed, that laughter carrying inexpressible desolation and sorrow, 'Heaven's cycle, justice is served. Back then I couldn't protect you; now I've亲手把你送上死局—perhaps this is my fate.'"

"Chen Ji stood frozen in place. He had schemed his entire life, plotted his entire life, believed he had seen through all things in the world, yet at this moment he found he truly did not know how to face this enemy—no, this blood-related elder. Ling Yuan's hatred was real, Ling Yuan's regret was real. He hated that Chen Xuan was chosen by the Tianji Record, hated that he was abandoned, but what he hated even more was that he couldn't protect his younger brother back then. This twisted interweaving of love and hatred had lasted for ten thousand years."

"The exit light of the secret realm suddenly became blinding, the transmission array had activated, meaning the trial was about to end and other disciples would arrive soon. Ling Yuan gave Chen Ji one deep look, that gaze carrying too many complex emotions, ultimately condensing into one meaningful sentence: 'Ji'er, see you at the Tianqing Sect. This game of chess, we've both played for too long.' With those words, his figure dissolved into the void, leaving only that ancient stone tablet standing silently in place."

"Chen Ji stood in place, not moving for a long time. The churning in his blood gradually calmed, yet the waves in his heart could not settle for a long while. He looked down at the Tianji Record fragment in his palm, that yellowed paper showing a faint phantom of Chen Xuan, as if sighing silently. He shared blood with Ling Yuan and origin with Chen Xuan; Chen Xuan's obsession, the Tianji Record's destiny, Ling Yuan's regret—all intertwined into a net from which he was sinking deeper and deeper."

"But he was not Chen Xuan. He was Chen Ji, that Chen Ji who walked the world under a waste persona and whose calculations never failed. Ling Yuan wanted to use him as a chess piece? Chen Xuan's obsession wanted to drag him into a trap? The Tianji Record's destiny wanted to crush him? Heh—he coldly laughed in his heart, that smile more miserable than crying, yet sharper than ever. Since all of you want to play this chess game, I'll play it out with you to the end. Only this time, the one holding the pieces can only be myself."

"The transmission array's light engulfed Chen Ji, the scene before his eyes rapidly changing. When he opened his eyes again, he was already standing on the plaza at the secret realm's exit, surrounded by bustling trial disciples. Someone was showing off their gains, someone was exchanging information, yet Chen Ji heard nothing, standing in the crowd like an isolated island. The aftershock in his blood had not yet fully subsided; in the depths of his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's final words echoed like a ghost: 'Child, your path is still long. Remember, whether you are Chen Xuan or Chen Ji, you are yourself.'"
